mapper.select: SELECT id, room_id AS roomId, title, description, start_time AS startTime, end_time AS endTime, voting, creator_user_id AS creatorUserId, deleted FROM poll WHERE room_id = #{roomId}
SELECT id, room_id AS roomId, title, description, start_time AS startTime, end_time AS endTime, voting, creator_user_id AS creatorUserId, deleted FROM poll WHERE room_id = #{roomId} AND deleted = 0

SELECT id, room_id AS roomId, title, description, start_time AS startTime, end_time AS endTime, voting, creator_user_id AS creatorUserId, deleted FROM poll WHERE creator_user_id = #{creatorUserId} AND deleted = 1 ORDER BY end_time DESC, id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO poll(room_id, title, description, voting, creator_user_id, deleted) VALUES(#{roomId}, #{title}, #{description}, #{voting}, #{creatorUserId}, #{deleted})
